title: Every May day’s high in Delhi, decade by decade
note: Each ridge holds every May day’s high in one decade. This is reanalysis, a model fitted to observations, not the station record.
geography: New Delhi (28.6° N, 77.2° E; ERA5 grid cell)

sources.maker: ECMWF Copernicus Climate Change Service (ERA5 reanalysis)
sources.dataset: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API, daily 2 m temperature maximum and minimum
